recipe.visualDefinition: A high-key studio portrait of a woman in eclectic fashion, framed by a bold, rounded red border and a central pale yellow circular glow. The composition balances sharp, condensed black typography on the left with a bold red serif title on the right.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject centered against a soft circular glow to create depth
Bold red graphic frame contrasting with a cream-white background
Typographic weight balanced across the horizontal axis
Eclectic textures (denim, lace, fishnets) against a clean graphic backdrop
coreInvariants: Pale yellow circular halo behind the subject
High-contrast lighting with warm skin tones
Mix of ultra-condensed and bold serif typefaces

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject is centrally positioned, mid-shot, filling the vertical space from the waist up with legs crossed in the foreground.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face and the yellow circular glow behind her head.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the top-left text, moves to the subject's face, follows her gaze to the right-side text, and settles on the foreground textures.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Ample cream-white space around the subject to allow for large-scale typography.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Cream-white background providing a clean canvas.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Vibrant red used for the frame and secondary title.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Pale yellow glow and black primary typography.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the red elements against desaturated, high-value background tones.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: A mix of ultra-condensed sans-serif/serif hybrid and a heavy slab-serif.
letterConstructionRules: Primary text: Extreme vertical elongation with very tight apertures.
Secondary text: High-contrast thick and thin strokes with sharp, bracketed serifs.
characterSpecificRedesigns: Primary text features uniform stroke widths and flat terminals.
Secondary text features a distinct 'W' with overlapping center strokes.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Extreme width contrast: ultra-compressed black text paired with wide, heavy red serif text.

preserve: High contrast of the secondary text
Red and black color split for text

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the ultra-condensed, high-impact verticality of the primary name.
Captures the high-contrast, heavy-weight editorial feel of the title text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a studio portrait of a woman in a yellow slip dress and denim jacket, holding a crossword book and pencil. Place her against a cream background with a soft yellow circular glow behind her head. Add a thick red frame with large rounded corners that cuts into the edges of the square canvas.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add the primary name in the top left using an ultra-condensed black font. Add the secondary title in the middle right using a bold, high-contrast red serif font.

verificationChecks: Is the red frame present in the corners?
Is the primary text vertically elongated?
Is there a soft yellow glow behind the subject?
Is the secondary text red and high-contrast?

adjustableVariables: Specific props held by the subject
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the red frame does not obscure the subject's face.
Check that the black text is legible despite its compression.
Verify the yellow glow is subtle and centered.
Confirm the overall square aspect ratio.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a high-fashion studio portrait with a graphic 'halo' and 'frame' system, using extreme typographic width contrast to define the editorial hierarchy.
